overview.text: FluxA presents agent-payment infrastructure spanning AgentWallet, single-use AgentCard, AgentMarket discovery, AgentCharge USDC acceptance and AI spending management. Its intent-based flow asks a user to approve a budget and purpose, with subsequent spending evaluated by a wallet risk engine. Payment Security is labelled beta. Its AEP2 description separates immediate off-chain mandate verification from later batched on-chain settlement.
